disputable.why: Players are unsure how to say Hwei ("hway" vs "hoo-ay"); one syllable is the official pronunciation.
Some players jokingly say "sing-ed"; the standard reading is one syllable.
Dictionaries give two syllables (BRY-er), though many say it as one; expect arguments either way.
